title: How to Create a RefMod for MiniMax H3 — No Training Required
description:
In this video, I take a look at RefMods for MiniMax H3, explain how they differ from LoRAs, and walk through creating one from my own reference footage. I also test how well it preserves identity and whether RefMods are a practical alternative to traditional LoRA training.



ComfyUI-MiniMaxH3Mod - https://github.com/Luisacaotica/ComfyUI-MiniMaxH3Mod

ComfyUI-H3RefMods - https://github.com/FranckyB/ComfyUI-H3RefModPicker (this was updated after the video was posted)

ComfyUI-Spectrum-MiniMax-H3 - https://github.com/xmarre/ComfyUI-Spectrum-MiniMax-H3

Workflow: https://huggingface.co/datasets/malcolmrey/workflows/blob/main/H3/workflow_minimaxh3_refmod.json


Chapters: 

0:00 - Downloading Custom Nodes
1:20 - Creating the RefMod
3:21 - Generating a video 
5:22 - Comparing outputs
6:00 - Outro
